# NEW 2026-11-22 v18.0 Module 18.0-A: Scripted Triggers for Multilateral IO Resolutions & 7 Civilization Parliaments (oe_io3_triggers.txt) (oe_io3_, 0 mainline slots, 0 rules, 0 vanilla overrides). Generated by gen_v180_resolutions_parliaments.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Strictly 0 bare if/else/else_if blocks. All country checks enforce is_rebel_country = no.

oe_io3_is_eligible_realm = {
	is_rebel_country = no
	num_locations > 0
	country_type = location
}

# 1. Byzantine / Roman / Elysian Senate civilization scope
oe_io3_is_byz_parl_civ = {
	oe_io3_is_eligible_realm = yes
	OR = {
		has_or_had_tag = BYZ
		has_or_had_tag = ROM
		parliament_type ?= parliament_type:oe_imperial_council
		parliament_type ?= parliament_type:oe_roman_republic
	}
}

# 2. Great Yuan Kurultai civilization scope
oe_io3_is_yuan_parl_civ = {
	oe_io3_is_eligible_realm = yes
	OR = {
		has_or_had_tag = CHI
		has_or_had_tag = YUA
		has_or_had_tag = GLH
		has_or_had_tag = MOG
		has_or_had_tag = TIM
		parliament_type ?= parliament_type:oe_yuan_kurultai
		culture ?= { has_culture_group = culture_group:mongolian_group }
	}
}

# 3. Ming / Qing Six Ministries civilization scope
oe_io3_is_ming_parl_civ = {
	oe_io3_is_eligible_realm = yes
	OR = {
		has_or_had_tag = MNG
		has_or_had_tag = MCH
		parliament_type ?= parliament_type:oe_ming_six_ministries
		culture ?= { has_culture_group = culture_group:chinese_group }
		culture ?= { has_culture_group = culture_group:jurchen_group }
	}
}

# 4. Ottoman Imperial Divan civilization scope
oe_io3_is_ott_parl_civ = {
	oe_io3_is_eligible_realm = yes
	OR = {
		has_or_had_tag = TUR
		parliament_type ?= parliament_type:oe_ottoman_divan
	}
}

# 5. Russian Zemsky Sobor civilization scope
oe_io3_is_rus_parl_civ = {
	oe_io3_is_eligible_realm = yes
	OR = {
		has_or_had_tag = MOS
		has_or_had_tag = RUS
		has_or_had_tag = NOV
		parliament_type ?= parliament_type:oe_rus_zemsky_sobor
		culture ?= { has_culture_group = culture_group:russian_group }
	}
}

# 6. Mamluk Sultanic Majlis civilization scope
oe_io3_is_mam_parl_civ = {
	oe_io3_is_eligible_realm = yes
	OR = {
		has_or_had_tag = MAM
		parliament_type ?= parliament_type:oe_mamluk_majlis
	}
}

# 7. European / HRE Estates General civilization scope
oe_io3_is_eur_parl_civ = {
	oe_io3_is_eligible_realm = yes
	OR = {
		AND = {
			exists = international_organization:hre
			is_member_of_international_organization = international_organization:hre
		}
		has_or_had_tag = HAB
		has_or_had_tag = FRA
		has_or_had_tag = ENG
		has_or_had_tag = GBR
		has_or_had_tag = CAS
		has_or_had_tag = SPA
		has_or_had_tag = POL
		has_or_had_tag = PLC
		has_or_had_tag = BOH
		has_or_had_tag = BRA
		has_or_had_tag = PRU
		AND = {
			capital ?= { continent = continent:europe }
			OR = {
				parliament_type ?= parliament_type:estate_parliament
				parliament_type ?= parliament_type:constitutional_parliament
				parliament_type ?= parliament_type:dutch_parliament
				parliament_type ?= parliament_type:plc_parliament
			}
		}
	}
}

# Any of the 7 civilizations participating in Module 18.0-A native parliaments
oe_io3_is_any_civ_parl = {
	OR = {
		oe_io3_is_byz_parl_civ = yes
		oe_io3_is_yuan_parl_civ = yes
		oe_io3_is_ming_parl_civ = yes
		oe_io3_is_ott_parl_civ = yes
		oe_io3_is_rus_parl_civ = yes
		oe_io3_is_mam_parl_civ = yes
		oe_io3_is_eur_parl_civ = yes
	}
}

# Safe multi-IO membership check (strictly separates unique = no autocephalous_patriarchate)
oe_io3_is_in_major_io = {
	oe_io3_is_eligible_realm = yes
	OR = {
		is_member_of_international_organization_of_type = { type = autocephalous_patriarchate }
		AND = {
			exists = international_organization:middle_kingdom
			is_member_of_international_organization = international_organization:middle_kingdom
		}
		AND = {
			exists = international_organization:hre
			is_member_of_international_organization = international_organization:hre
		}
		AND = {
			exists = international_organization:catholic_church
			is_member_of_international_organization = international_organization:catholic_church
		}
		AND = {
			exists = international_organization:tatar_yoke
			is_member_of_international_organization = international_organization:tatar_yoke
		}
		AND = {
			exists = international_organization:japanese_shogunate
			is_member_of_international_organization = international_organization:japanese_shogunate
		}
		AND = {
			exists = international_organization:oe_io_eurasian_concert
			is_member_of_international_organization = international_organization:oe_io_eurasian_concert
		}
	}
}
